Pager.description: Horizontal pages that snap one at a time, like Compose HorizontalPager. Each child is a page as wide as the pager (less 2 × (peek + pageSpacing) when peek is set); only the pages in or next to the viewport are rendered, and pages swiped away are disposed, so keep any state that must survive in the data model. At most 50 pages. Takes the width it is offered; as tall as style.height / aspectRatio, otherwise as its tallest rendered page. Has no indicator of its own: bind currentPage and a DotIndicator to the same path. Gestures belong to a Clickable inside a page, not to the pager.

children.description: One page per child, as component ids or a template expansion. Only the first 50 are drawn.

currentPage.description: Index of the page shown, from 0. Bound to a path it is two-way: a swipe, an autoPlay step or a DotIndicator tap writes the new page there, and writing the path from outside (updateData, updateDataModel) animates the pager to it. Floored, then wrapped when loop is on and clamped to the last page when it is not; the corrected value is written back. Defaults to 0.

loop.description: Joins the last page to the first, so swiping and autoPlay never stop. No effect with fewer than 2 pages. Defaults to false. Literal only.

autoPlay.description: Advances one page every interval once the pager has settled. Without loop, the last page goes back to the first. Pauses while touched, while the pager is off screen or the app is in the background, and never runs when the system asks for reduced motion. Unset does not auto-play.

interval.description: Milliseconds between pages. Below 2000 is raised to 2000.

userScrollEnabled.description: Whether a swipe turns the page. False still lets currentPage and autoPlay turn it. Defaults to true.

style.description: How the component is drawn. Anything left out stays at whatever the design system already decided.

pageSpacing.description: Gap between two neighbouring pages, in dp. Defaults to 0.

peek.description: How much of each neighbouring page shows beside the current one, in dp. Defaults to 0: pages are as wide as the pager.

containerColor.description: Which `tokens.json` color role the pager is filled with, under its padding.

shape.description: Corner radius of the pager in dp, or a `tokens.json` shape role. Pages are clipped to it.

count.description: How many dots. A number is floored; bound to an array it is the array's length. Held to 0–50.

current.description: Index of the highlighted dot, from 0. Out of range is shown clamped and not written back. Defaults to 0.

interactive.description: When true, tapping dot i writes i to current, which turns a Pager bound to the same path. Defaults to false.

ChoiceGroup.description: Selects one or more options, each drawn by a template component fed with the option's uiData. The group owns the selection state, the item frame and the selection indicator; the template only draws content.

options.description: Option data together with the option template.

items.description: Path to the option array in the data model; literals and function calls are not accepted. Each entry is { uiData, value }: uiData is a plain object (not a binding) that relative paths in the template resolve against; value is a string unique within the group.

componentId.description: Component id of the option template, instantiated once per option and scoped to its uiData.

value.description: Values of the selected options. Always a string array; at most one entry in mutuallyExclusive.

indicator.description: How selection is shown. `control` draws a radio or check control and only that control toggles selection (see toggleArea); `border` wraps each option in a container, outlines the selected ones, and the whole option toggles selection; `none` draws no frame or control, the whole option toggles selection, and the template shows the selected state itself through `@selected`.

toggleArea.description: What a tap toggles on when indicator is `control`: only the control, or the whole option. Ignored for `border` and `none`, where the whole option always toggles. Components inside the template that declare their own action still answer the tap themselves.

focusInputOnSelect.description: When a user taps an option to select it, focus the first TextField in that option and open the keyboard. Does not focus on initial render or when selection changes through data binding. Tapping inside a TextField retains its normal focus behavior; deselecting an option never requests focus.

optionEnabled.description: Whether one option answers the user, evaluated in each option's scope: relative paths read that option's uiData, `@index` is its index and `@selected` its current state. `false` makes the option ignore taps on its frame, control and template, keeps its selection exactly as it is, disables every component in its template the way `enabled` does, reports it as disabled to accessibility, and draws the group's `style.disabled.effect` over the whole option (frame, outline and control included), 40% opacity by default. A disabled group disables every option whatever this says. A value that is missing, fails to resolve or is not a boolean counts as true.

action.description: Runs after each user tap on an option, once the selection has been written back to `value`, including a tap on an already selected option in mutuallyExclusive. It runs in the tapped option's scope: relative paths read that option's uiData, `@index` is the option index and `@selected` its new state. Changes to `value` that do not come from a tap do not run it. The renderer starts it with invokeAction("option:<i>"), where i is the option's position among the rendered options.

indicatorAlign.description: Side the control sits on. Only used when indicator is `control`.

selectedEffect.description: Visual effect over the whole rendering of a selected option: template content, control, and in border mode the frame fill and outline. Visual only; the option stays interactive. `dimmed` overlays the basic_container_primary color at 70% opacity.

spacing.description: Step between options, in dp. Defaults to 12 for control and 4 for border.

itemPadding.description: Inset inside each option frame, in dp. Defaults to 0 for control and none, and 14 for border.

pressedColor.description: Color role from `tokens.json` filling the option frame while it is pressed. Only drawn where the whole option toggles: border, none, or control with toggleArea `option`. Unset draws no pressed state.

itemShape.description: Corner radius of each option frame, in dp or a `tokens.json` shape role; it also clips the pressed fill. Defaults to 0 for control and none, and 16 for border.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

lessThanOrEqual.description: True when a <= b. Null operands coerce to 0.

a.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

equalsNumber.description: True when a == b. Null operands coerce to 0.

a.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

equalsString.description: True when string a equals string b. Null operands coerce to empty string.

a.description: String literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: String literal, data binding, or nested function call.

isEmpty.description: True when value is null, empty string, empty array, or empty object.

value.description: Literal, data binding, or nested function call.

contains.description: True when the array values holds an element deeply equal to value. Numbers compare by value. A values that is not an array yields false.

values.description: Array literal, data binding, or nested function call.

value.description: Literal, data binding, or nested function call.

map.description: Map a data-model array in order. items must be a path binding. Evaluate template once per item in that item's scope; relative paths, @index and @indexValue refer to the item, absolute paths retain the model root. Empty arrays return []; non-arrays and failed item evaluations fail the whole call. Object and array literals in template are evaluated field by field, so a template can build one object per item. Does not write to the data model.

template.description: Literal, data binding or nested function call, evaluated in each item scope. Object and array literals are evaluated field by field; an object with a string path or call is a binding or call.

filter.description: The elements of items whose field equals any element of in, in their original order. A missing field reads as null. A non-array items yields []; a non-array in is treated as a one-element array.

items.description: Array literal, data binding, or nested function call.

field.description: JSON Pointer relative to each element, such as `value` or `uiData/editor`. Omit to compare the element itself.

in.description: Candidate values: array literal, data binding, or nested function call.

join.description: Joins the display text of each element of values with separator. With field, each element contributes the first listed field that is not empty. Null, empty strings, objects and arrays are skipped without leaving an extra separator.

values.description: Array literal, data binding, or nested function call.

separator.description: Placed between joined entries. Defaults to the empty string.

field.description: JSON Pointer relative to each element, or an array of them tried in order.

select.description: Evaluates and returns then when condition is true, else otherwise (null when else is omitted). Only the chosen branch is evaluated. The result may be any JSON value, including a whole style object.

condition.description: Boolean or validation result: literal, data binding, or nested function call.

else.description: Value when condition is false. Defaults to null.

add.description: a + b. Null operands coerce to 0.

a.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

subtract.description: a - b. Null operands coerce to 0.

a.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

multiply.description: a * b. Null operands coerce to 0.

a.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

b.description: Number literal, data binding, or nested function call.

urlEncode.description: Percent-encode value per RFC 3986 unreserved set. Spaces become %20.

value.description: String literal, data binding, or nested function call.

updateData.description: Atomically write entries into this surface's data model. Null value deletes the path.

path.description: Literal JSON Pointer.

value.description: Literal, data binding, or nested function call.

toast.description: Show a host toast with message.

message.description: String literal, data binding, or nested function call.

copyContent.description: Copy content onto the host clipboard.

content.description: String literal, data binding, or nested function call.

publishDataModel.description: Hand this surface's whole data model to the host as an action named publishDataModel, with the snapshot in context.dataModel. The host uploads it; the renderer sends nothing itself.

sequence.description: Run actions in order. Each action is parsed just before it runs.

waitForResults.description: When true, a direct step whose result is pending (agent or async host function) holds the remaining steps until its result is written. A failed step stops the sequence; a superseded, cancelled or timed-out step reports SEQUENCE_INTERRUPTED. Nested sequences wait only for their own steps.

awaitTimeoutMs.description: Literal per-step wait limit in milliseconds; 0 waits indefinitely. Requires waitForResults: true and a host event loop.

switch.description: Run the first case whose literal match equals value, or default.

value.description: Literal, data binding, or nested function call.

setTimeout.description: Run action after delay milliseconds. Cancelled when the surface is destroyed.

closeModal.description: Close the Modal with this literal id. Nested modals inside it close with it.

rendererVersionAtLeast.description: True when the host rendererVersion is a semver at least version.

Insets.description: Inset in dp. A number applies to every side; an object insets the sides it names and leaves the rest at whatever the broader key gave them.

all.description: Every side no other key names.

start.description: The leading end — the left in a left-to-right surface.

end.description: The trailing end — the right in a left-to-right surface.

CommonStyle.description: Layout and inset keys shared by every xCard component style bag.

width.description: Width of the component, in dp. Unset takes what the parent offers.

height.description: Height of the component, in dp. Unset is as tall as the content.

padding.description: Inset around the component, in dp.

fillMaxWidth.description: Fraction of the parent's available width, 0 to 1. Ignored when the parent width is wrap-content, or when width or a live weight already sizes this axis.

fillMaxHeight.description: Fraction of the parent's available height, 0 to 1. Ignored when the parent height is wrap-content, or when height or a live weight already sizes this axis.

aspectRatio.description: Width over height used to compute the missing axis. Ignored when both axes are already determined.

DisabledStyle.description: How the component is drawn while it is disabled — its own `enabled` or an ancestor's is false. `effect` is drawn over the whole rendering. Every other key replaces the same key of this style while disabled, and only color keys are taken (`color`, `tint` and any key ending in `Color`, each a color role from `tokens.json`), so `{"containerColor": "basic_container_secondary"}` swaps the background; sizes, padding and other layout keys are ignored, so disabling never moves anything.

DisabledEffect.description: Visual effect over the whole rendering of a disabled component, content and children included. Unset draws `fade` on the outermost disabled component and nothing on the components inside it, so opacity never multiplies down a disabled subtree; a component inside one draws an effect only when it declares one here. `fade` is 40% opacity; `{"type":"fade","alpha":a}` picks the opacity (default 0.4); `{"type":"grayscale","alpha":a}` removes the color and then applies the opacity (default 1); `none` draws nothing, for a card that shows the disabled state through color keys alone.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the data model

CombinedActions.description: Per-gesture actions. Mutually exclusive with action. At least one gesture, and every one of them is a full Action — the same shape the action property takes. A gesture left out is not an action: invoking it fails rather than falling back to click, so a Column that binds only longPress stays untappable. The nearest component that declares any gesture answers the touch and it stops there, so a tappable child inside a tappable container runs the child's action alone. A gesture name this renderer does not know is ignored rather than rejected, which is what lets a card bind one a later renderer will add.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the data model.

Tracking.description: This action's click anchor, reported when the action fires.

Throttle.description: Leading-only throttle shared by surfaceId + id.

toast.description: Optional message shown when a call is dropped.

Action.description: An interaction handler: either an agent-side event or a renderer / agent function call, never both.

checks.description: Skip this action when a rule fails.
Skip this action when a rule fails.

RichTextSpan.description: One run of text inside a RichText.

text.description: The run's text, as plain text. Same shapes as Text.text; Markdown and HTML are not interpreted. A run whose text resolves to empty is not drawn.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the data model

action.description: Runs when this span is tapped. It is evaluated on tap only, never when the span is read. The tap is consumed and does not reach ancestors.

RichTextSpanStyle.description: Text styling shared by RichText and its spans. On a span every key falls back to the RichText style, then to the variant's typography. Size and line height always come from the RichText variant.

color.description: Which `tokens.json` color role the text is drawn in. A span with an action and no color of its own is drawn in basic_text_link; the RichText style.color does not apply to it.

textDecoration.description: Line drawn with the text. A span's value replaces, rather than adds to, the one it would inherit.

fontStyle.description: Upright or italic. Hosts synthesize a slant where the typeface has no italic face.
